title: Email templates
intro: The words of every email the site sends. Edit the subject and the body as plain text. The site puts them inside its email design.

settingsLink.heading: Email templates
settingsLink.text: The subject and body of each email the site sends, in Arabic and English.

subject: Subject
subjectHint: One line. Keep the tag in square brackets at the start: it sorts the inbox.
bodyHint: Plain text only. Leave an empty line to start a new paragraph.
placeholdersHint: Type a placeholder exactly as shown, with its double braces. The site replaces it with the real value when it sends the email.

placeholders.consultationId: The consultation's number in the system
placeholders.title: The consultation's title
placeholders.startsAt: The meeting's date and time, in the recipient's time zone
placeholders.name: The sender's name
placeholders.subject: The message's subject

previewHint: With sample values. Any HTML tag you type shows as plain text.
saved: Saved. The next email of this kind uses your text.
resetQuestion: Replace your text with the default text, in both languages?
resetDone: Reset. The next email of this kind uses the default text.

errors.tooLong: Too long. Use {max} characters or fewer.
errors.unknownPlaceholder: This email has no value for: {names}. Use only the placeholders listed for it.
